message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Guidelines | | **Seat‑belt & Child Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster.
• Children under 5 must be in a rear‑seat child safety seat. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited (unless using a hands‑free system).
• Texting while driving is illegal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21 (BAC 0.02% or higher).
• Penalties: fines, license suspension, possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Right‑of‑Way Rules** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at red lights and stop signs.
• “Right‑of‑way” at intersections without signs: yield to vehicles on the right. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for a school bus with its stop sign extended and lights flashing.
• Vehicles must stop on both sides of the road. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Keep a safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights may be used only when visibility is less than 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or stop sign.
• No parking in a driveway or on a private property without permission. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • All vehicles must be registered and display a valid license plate.
• Most vehicles must pass an annual safety inspection. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) | | **Towing & Tow‑away** | • Towing is allowed only after a 15‑minute waiting period, unless the vehicle is a hazard.
• Towing a vehicle that is not a hazard may result in a fine. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Emergency Vehicles** | • Drivers must yield to emergency vehicles with flashing lights or sirens. | Texas Transportation Code §545.021 | | **Special Situations** | • **Snow & Ice**: Use winter tires or chains if required.
• **Construction Zones**: Follow posted signs and reduced speed limits. | TxDOT Construction Zone Guidelines | --- ### How to Get Official, Up‑to‑Date Information 1. **Texas Transportation Code** – The primary source for all traffic laws. *Website:* https://statutes.capitol.texas.gov/Docs/TRAN/htm/TRAN.545.htm 2. **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Provides road‑condition updates, speed‑limit guidelines, and safety campaigns. *Website:* https://www.txdot.gov/ 3. **Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV)** – Handles registration, licensing, and inspection requirements. *Website:* https://www.txdmv.gov/ 4. **Local County or City Ordinances** – Some municipalities have additional rules (e.g., specific speed limits, parking restrictions). Check your local city or county website. --- ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas - **Always keep a safe following distance** – especially on highways where speeds are higher. - **Use your headlights** from dusk till dawn and during inclement weather. - **Avoid distractions** – no texting, no handheld calls. - **Know your limits** – if you’re tired or impaired, do not drive. - **Respect school buses and pedestrians** – they have the right of way. Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law, penalty, or how to handle a particular driving scenario!
